body:
🕒 GameTimeLeaderboard

A lightweight and efficient Bukkit plugin that tracks and showcases player playtime on your Minecraft server, bringing a new level of engagement to your community.

## ✨ Features

- **Dynamic Leaderboard**: Real-time sidebar display showing top 5 players with the most playtime
- **Player Lookup**: Check any player's playtime with the simple `/playtime <player>` command
- **User-Friendly Format**: Displays time in hours (with 2 decimal places) for easy reading
- **Offline Support**: Includes data for all players who have ever joined your server

## 🎮 Usage

1. The leaderboard automatically appears in the right sidebar for all online players
2. Use `/playtime [playerName]` to check specific player statistics
3. Watch as rankings shift in real-time as players accumulate more game time

Perfect for fostering friendly competition, recognizing dedicated community members, or creating playtime-based rewards and challenges on your server!
